quantity: first_term x proposal-year interaction in strict member-bill passage (pp per year).
comparison: First-term vs re-elected sponsors across proposal years.
supporting_result: Interaction that halves the year-1 gap by year 3 (+0.5 to +1.25pp per year).
decisive_metric: Pooled interaction and 95 percent interval with the within-year censoring control.
falsifying_result: Interaction indistinguishable from zero or negative.

lit_a.quoted_prediction: We found that effectiveness rises sharply with tenure, at least for the first few terms, even when we control for legislators' institutional positions, party affiliation, and other factors.

claims.quantity: First-term minus re-elected strict passage rate among year-1 member bills (pp).
claims.decisive_metric: Adjusted year-1 gap and 95 percent interval.

spec_plan.model: LPM passed ~ first_term x prop_year + assembly FE + bloc + election_type + committee FE, clustered by sponsor
spec_plan.what_result_would_mean: A zero or negative interaction would mean the learning prior is overturned.
